required_cases: Reconstruct dense committed extents by ordinal and stream with exact declaration positions and bytes.
Classify absent dependencies as loading, ACP denial as denied, distinct twins as conflicted, and malformed sealed runs as invalid.
Ignore benign late flushes beyond a selected sealed extent while rejecting in-extent twins.
Treat raw exact duplicate facts idempotently without normalizing the fixture before the native adapter sees them.
Reconstruct native reasoning parts, opaque payload retention, tool argument JSON, tool results, media metadata, roles, publication metadata, signatures, and native IDs exactly.
Project live output only for the exact current request generation or eligible physical tool owner; closed output is never a live preview.
Require exact terminal selection before exposing retained Partial diagnostics and never promote retained bytes into an authored answer.
Feed reconstructed native messages, not mutable response summaries, into provider sanitization and token budgeting.
Preserve assistant tool-call and user tool-result pairing across strip, provider-view, split, summary, and retained-tail boundaries.
Use native provider call IDs rather than physical tool document IDs when matching pairs and detecting reused keys.
Advance the compaction cursor only across a provider-stable published prefix below the shared sequence allocator.
Show provider-view fixpoint and prefix stability under later canonical publication, including forked headers and background notification pairs.
Replace LeanCompactionReducerCase.response_status with the modeled publication_ready, provider_fixpoint, and turn_boundary checks instead of restoring response lifecycle state.
Replace the response-status gate only after its surviving published-prefix guarantee is exercised on concrete native inputs.

The formal projection/estimate/reduction boundary has its own projection-compaction-threshold-join entry. It does not upgrade these summary-only reducer/cursor rows or prove native serialization. The real serialized-request experiment remains native.external-projected-request-threshold.
Still summary-only: the reducer and cursor cases. Their concrete row inputs must be exported before the response-status gate is replaced.
Resolve exact selected canonical identities to reconstructed native messages without silently dropping a missing, ambiguous or incomplete publication.
Drive reduction from the estimate of the projected complete request, including fixed request layers through the existing native callback; never substitute stored or presented payload sums.
Exercise equality and one-over budget, projection/estimation failure, invalid reduction partitions, and exact checkpoint-plus-suffix rebuilding.
Reproject and remeasure after reduction or provider-view repair, rejecting a still-over-budget request or one with no positive output capacity.

Controlled projection observations exercise the formal composition only. Run native.external-projected-request-threshold to validate the real serializer and estimator; native consumer coverage is still pending.
Compare stored and reconstructed payload lengths for full presentation, literals, head/tail windows and missing dependencies.
This group covers reconstruction only: payload counts exclude metadata, URLs, escaping and request structure and do not establish provider sizing or a compaction decision.
The actual serialized-request estimate/threshold join is tracked separately by native.external-projected-request-threshold.
Export ordered before/after observations and exact before/after views rather than isolated final projection summaries.
Show a contiguous open source growing from one valid UTF-8 prefix to a longer prefix without rewind under benign immutable delivery.
Interleave header arrival, closure arrival, extent segments, exact replay, foreign-source facts, denial evidence, and owner-liveness changes in distinct traces.
Keep missing ordinal observations loading or settling until reconstructable; never infer liveness solely from the absence of a closure.
Demonstrate that conflicting twins and malformed consumed runs fail closed and are excluded from the benign-extension premise.
Drive desktop reordered-query and observer-patch behavior from the same trace expectations; canonical_output_projection_cases currently exports isolated observations only.
Fork by copying native headers only, preserving numeric sequence, payload references, outcome, and exact origin while removing live request membership.
Reject fork metadata mismatch, reordered child headers, missing origins, conflicting origins, and denied origins with distinct outcomes.
Build an authorized transitive manifest containing selected headers, every referenced closure and extent segment, terminal selection dependencies, and recursive fork origins.
Permit authorized fork dependencies across sessions without treating arbitrary parent-session history as selected.
Keep missing dependencies loading/incomplete, denial rejected, twins conflicted, and served completion contingent on exact signed identity coverage plus reconstruction.
Exercise actual document sets and expected manifests; the currently emitted hydration booleans and counts are insufficient native reconstruction inputs.
Resolve only the request's explicit terminal_output Message identity or explicit NoMessage; never select the latest visible assistant row.
Reject missing selection, missing or conflicting header identity, wrong request/session scope, non-assistant role, tool-delivery publication, fork publication, and ACP denial distinctly.
Reconstruct every dependency of the selected message before returning a subagent final result; missing remains incomplete and denied remains denied.
Bind child final-result reads to the authenticated physical child request and descendant edge, not a matching logical request ID or session sequence.
Ensure late background messages and unrelated headers cannot replace terminal selection after request terminalization.
Export concrete terminal selection, headers, segments, denials, expected native message or exact error; no terminal-selection fixture group currently exists.
On accepted Complete assistant request publication, reconstruct exactly the addressed tool call's argument stream and validate native JSON before copying it.
Reject Partial, recovery, fork, tool-delivery, retracted, malformed, wrong-source, unknown-call, and local-target attempts to create delegated input.
Bind copied bytes and source provenance to the exact physical addressed call, coordinator, and remote target in the publication transaction.
Ensure the remote host can consume authenticated delegated arguments without authority to hydrate the parent header, sibling streams, reasoning, text, or history.
Replay the same immutable delegated input and reject changed bytes or source identity without adding a second argument owner.
Export concrete records, message, intent, principals, expected delegated value or exact error; no canonical delegation fixture group currently exists.
Materialize provider input only from fully reconstructed canonical native messages selected in stable transcript order.

Validate role/block legality, publication shape, exact provider block and part positions, payload kind, tool identity, media metadata, UTF-8, JSON arguments, and presentation ranges before provider narrowing.

Preserve signed and encrypted reasoning, native IDs, tool signatures, call IDs, additional parameters, media details, and original argument bytes through reconstruction into provider-specific conversion.
Apply provider-input sanitization and compaction only after reconstruction; never repair a missing, denied, conflicting, malformed, or illegally ordered canonical dependency into a shorter prompt.
Narrow provider-specific wire fields without changing the canonical transcript or creating a second persisted message representation.

Export ordered canonical records/messages plus the exact reconstructed native list and narrowed provider request expectation; compaction summaries and prompt sanitizer fixtures do not cover this materialization join.
Derive request status only from lifecycle state while independently projecting absent, live, settling, loading, denied, conflicted, invalid, retracted, retained Partial, and published output views.
Do not turn a terminal request into running when its selected output header or payload dependency is missing.
Preserve retry-tip ambiguity rejection and supersession selection without response-status precedence or a response fallback.
Handle reordered header/segment arrival and exact duplicate observations without UI-local sync or loading heuristics.
Render only presentation-visible content while retaining native encrypted or redacted reasoning for reconstruction and provider input.
Export AttemptView plus canonical observation input and exact Client.projectOutput expectation; canonical_output_projection_cases currently covers only the output half of this join.
Drive desktop and CLI observation owners from the resulting joined fixtures rather than the stale AgentResponse readers.
